column1: Directors’ duties,"A director receives information tailored to maximise their knowledge and understanding of the following
• Key legal and regulatory provisions such as the Central Bank of Kenya Prudential Guidelines, Capital
Markets Authority Code on Corporate Governance and the Companies Act
• Summary rules on disclosing insider information
• Summary of the directors’ and officers’ liability insurance
• Conflicts of interests including all directorships and personal interests."
